rationale:
ROUND 2 (RESUBMIT_CORR 04a3ce1f). Every round-1 objection is answered by a measurement, a mechanism, or a coordination record - the full writeup is RFC_056 ADDENDUM 3 (committed alongside); the load-bearing ones:

1) debug_historian HIGH (the licence is 033's false claim): READ IN FULL and it was live against draft 1 in exactly the way the seat suspected - retraction closes feed the two-strike arm, so two retract->re-file cycles inside 7 days would brand the third re-file `unresolved` (033's close-feeds-strikes mechanics). THE FIX IS IN THIS REVISION: record rows now set `recurrenceExpected` - the flag's own doc-comment defines a normal re-request as exactly this shape (an action-like row whose re-observation is expected; bugs_open/024 is its precedent), the anti-churn arms are skipped, and idx_swi_dedup still enforces one open row per key. And 033's OTHER half (no scheduled next run) is where this case genuinely differs, now stated honestly: these seats run on the sweep's audit cadence ([MEASURED] 209->271 rows overnight), so re-file latency is BOUNDED BY THE AUDIT CADENCE (<= 14 days on a static site), and a DECOMMISSIONED seat has no next run - a stated residual, drained by the RUNBOOK queue.

2) prior_art_librarian HIGH (revalidate_review_queue may already cover this): it does not - workItemRevalidatableStatuses = ['needs_human_review','unresolved'] (work_items_common.go:142), `deferred` excluded; the 'humans only' claim was true and is now CITED. Why not extend that family: its closes are mechanical 'resolved' verdicts (a machine overruling a judgement lens - the tension ADDENDUM 1 ruled out) and its revalidators re-run a PREDICATE, which an opinion does not have.

3) guardian (quantify; stamper consistency; the crossed test): [MEASURED 2026-08-26] the enrolled population is 271 rows / 9 sites / 6 seats / 7 item types (largest: reader content_rewrite 36, content-quality content_rewrite 23, reader needs_content_page 22, brief-fidelity needs_content_page 21, site-review needs_content_planning 20; full table in grounded_in). Key consistency BOTH directions: 0 rows carry filing_mode with another value; 0 record rows lack audit_source; single writer (recordOnlyFinding), single reader (the loader), same literal, test-pinned. The crossed test file's owning lane (copy_quality_two_stage) gave EXPLICIT SIGN-OFF 2026-08-26 after running the three bound tests green themselves; the exchange is held in both lanes' records and the file is an explicit edit target below.

4) architecture (this deserves an RFC writeup, not a correction patch): RFC_056 ADDENDUM 3 is that writeup - blast radius quantified, rollback stated (Go-only revert; streak stamps inert without the pass that reads them), the licence restated with the brake interaction, and the post-roll pod verification named (service_binary_capabilities ancestry with both controls, then an induced two-direction test read from site_work_items).

5) reuse_agent (step zero): why not gates-map entries - a gate enrols a whole item TYPE and record rows share types with dispatch rows; enrolment must key on the row's MODE, which the map cannot express. Why a separate loader - the sibling returns one type's candidate ROWS, this returns the type DOMAIN; same predicate constant, different result shape.

6) editquality (incomplete sketches): every edit below carries the real code - the gated-loop call-site diff, the full second pass, the flag at all three sites, and the two previously-truncated tests in full.

THE ORIGINAL CASE, unchanged: RFC_056 ADDENDUM 1's revalidation claim was false for every type but dark_section_audit; 271 verdict rows currently have no lifecycle but a human; the default gate's licence is the self-correction asymmetry, now made EXACT by the recurrence flag.

plan.risks: 1) recurrenceExpected on record rows also skips the WITHIN-CYCLE defer arm - deliberate and stated: that arm exists to stop futile re-dispatch, and a record row dispatches nothing; there is nothing futile to brake. 2) A decommissioned seat's verdicts still park until a human drains them (the RUNBOOK queue) - the stated residual; the retraction can only be as alive as its seat. 3) The default threshold (3) is uncalibrated per type - accepted: a wrong retraction now genuinely costs one re-file at the audit cadence with no strike side-effects; if a type flaps visibly, that is the signal to give it a measured gate entry. 4) Post-roll verification is named in ADDENDUM 3 and is owed before this is called done: pod ancestry with both controls, then the induced two-direction test read from site_work_items. 5) DECLARED MISHAP: run f79e07be on this trail carried round 1's bytes (the submitting script died on a quoting error AFTER the dry-run validated the stale file, and the dispatch shipped what was on disk - live-and-committed are independent facts, applied to my own tooling). Its verdict duplicates round 1; this payload is the true revision.
